hosts.session_boundary: one transcript file per session; one usage record per API request (requestId)
hosts.caching: prompt cache across sessions on the same account; context_tokens = input + cache_read + cache_creation

hosts.session_boundary: one rollout file per session; one token_count event per request

forbidden_as_token_evidence: costUSD without the usage fields it was computed from

arms.control: packaged memesh with the current default recall output
arms.treatment: packaged memesh with the candidate output projection; same tools, same ground truth, same task prompt, same time limit

scoring.rule: each dimension is reported separately and never folded into a single score

privacy.corpus: synthetic only — no owner secrets, no private transcripts, no real owner graph
privacy.ledgers: numbers, identities and digests only — no prompt or completion text

statistics.paired_analysis: paired difference per case (treatment − control), same case order in both arms
statistics.freeze_rule: sample_size, repeats_per_case and minimum_meaningful_effect are set once from the pilot variance and then status becomes frozen; official runs are refused while status is pilot; thresholds are never changed after an official result is seen
